dct_description_sm: A first set of data evaluates the contribution of degrading permafrost to the mercury contamination of lakes and fish around Jean Marie River First Nation (JMRFN). Total mercury was analysed for 19 permafrost samples and can be compared to mercury contamination of fish and water of the same area (data collected by another project team and not included in these data sets). Other sets of data were developed to study the composition of permafrost and its content in ice, which gives information on the current conditions of permafrost and monitor its degradation. This allows to gain knowledge of the structure and current conditions of permafrost.
dct_title_s: Mercury contamination in permafrost in the Jean Marie River First Nation Lands (dehcho region)
